title: StemBind: When MLLMs Get Lost Between Rules and Instances in Abstract Visual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.00148v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often know the rule but pick the wrong answer: on abstract visual reasoning (AVR) tasks, a model can describe what it sees and name the underlying pattern, yet still fail to choose the matching candidate. Existing AVR benchmarks cannot detect this because they collapse perception, rule induction, and answer selection into a single right-or-wrong signal. We introduce StemBind, a shared-stem diagnostic benchmark that probes the same visual stem with three aligned questions: Perception (what is in the image), Rule (what pattern governs it), and Full (which option completes it), so a final-answer error can be attributed to a specific sub-step on the same evidence. StemBind contains 2,298 curated knowledge-light stems across nine auditable visual operations, totaling 19,533 P/R/F tasks, with each full item annotated by Sternberg's four reasoning stages (S1 Encode, S2 Infer, S3 Map, S4 Apply).

translated_title: StemBind：当多模态大语言模型在抽象视觉推理的规则与实例之间迷失时
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型往往“知道规则却选错答案”：在抽象视觉推理（AVR）任务上，模型能够描述所看到的内容并说出其中的潜在规律，却仍然无法选出匹配的候选项。现有的AVR基准无法检测到这一问题，因为它们将感知、规则归纳和答案选择压缩为单一的“对/错”信号。我们提出了StemBind，一个共享题干的诊断性基准，它用三个相互对应的问题来探测同一视觉题干：感知（图中有什么）、规则（什么规律支配它）和完整（哪个选项能完成它），从而可以在相同的证据上把最终答案的错误归因于某个具体的子步骤。StemBind包含2,298个精选的低知识依赖题干，涵盖九种可审计的视觉操作，共计19,533个感知/规则/完整（P/R/F）任务，且每个完整题目均按照Sternberg的四个推理阶段（S1编码、S2推断、S3映射、S4应用）进行标注。
tldr: StemBind通过针对同一视觉题干的感知、规则、完整三步诊断问题，将多模态大语言模型在抽象视觉推理中的错误精确定位到具体的推理子步骤。
en_tdlr: StemBind is a diagnostic benchmark that pinpoints MLLMs' abstract visual reasoning errors to specific sub-steps by probing the same visual stem with aligned Perception, Rule, and Full questions.
